interpretation_boundary: These bundles are directional structural-solvency scenario evidence over the disclosed tested region (baseline and stable presets, deterministic, repetitions=1). They are not forecasts, probability estimates, launch approval, or investment, legal, financial, or decision-grade advice; live launch, investment, or legal decisions require qualified review and evidence outside these artifacts.

metrics.aggregation: single deterministic run value at each epoch
metrics.description: Drawdown ratio of the audience reserve against its initial balance; terminal values below 0.3 classify the scenario as collapse.
metrics.label: Audience reserve ratio

metrics.aggregation: single deterministic run value at each epoch
metrics.description: Treasury balance after fees, top-ups, and ecosystem inflows at each epoch.
metrics.label: Treasury balance

metrics.aggregation: single deterministic run value at each epoch
metrics.description: Outstanding requested settlement volume queued behind the per-epoch settlement capacity.
metrics.label: Settlement queue

metrics.aggregation: single deterministic run value at each epoch
metrics.description: Throttle flag: 1 in epochs where the settlement throttle reduced outflows under reserve stress.
metrics.label: Settlement throttle state

metrics.aggregation: single deterministic run value at each epoch
metrics.description: Cumulative token burn from the utility-spend burn share; part of the per-epoch conservation identity.
metrics.label: Cumulative tokens burned

provenance.detail: Z1 M1 source anchors (cohort shares, verification rates, per-cohort issue rates) map to observed anchors; provisional defaults (economics, settlement, throttle parameters) map to assumed; deferred registry entries stay deferred. No parameter in this profile is calibrated to observed data.

repeatability.explanation: For these reviewed scenarios, matching config hash and seed produce matching canonical table-content hashes. Exact file hashes also include the unique run_id lineage field.

iteration_summary.role: per-epoch descriptive summary of the deterministic run

results.role: one row per simulation epoch for the single deterministic run

terminal_metrics.description: Reserve ratio at the final epoch; below 0.3 classifies collapse.
terminal_metrics.label: Final audience reserve ratio

terminal_metrics.description: Treasury balance at the final epoch.
terminal_metrics.label: Final treasury balance

terminal_metrics.description: Largest queued settlement volume observed in any epoch.
terminal_metrics.label: Maximum settlement queue

terminal_metrics.description: Number of epochs with the settlement throttle active.
terminal_metrics.label: Throttle epochs

terminal_metrics.description: Total cumulative burn at the final epoch.
terminal_metrics.label: Total tokens burned

terminal_metrics.description: Terminal classification from the Z1 summarizer: collapse iff final reserve ratio < 0.3; stressed iff throttle active or queue above the stress threshold; else stable. Carried in the bundle diagnostics and gallery index, not a per-epoch column.
terminal_metrics.label: Solvency classification

tested_region.disclosure: 2/3 named scenarios published (baseline, stable); 1/3 blocked upstream with the failure recorded (collapse_case, L10 hard assertion in Z1's config validation); deterministic runs at repetitions=1 over 104 weekly epochs with seed 42; no Monte Carlo uncertainty is claimed.

grid.label: cli_only_evidence
grid.note: The 27-case stress grid is CLI-only published evidence with exact completed/total counts; any subset carries the wiring_proof label. It is never a gallery comparison.

blocked.reason: Blocked upstream: Z1's own config.validate() raises its L10 hard assertion (weighted settle propensity exceeds weighted utility spend rate) for the collapse configuration; pre-existing since the first Z1 commit. No bundle is fabricated for a scenario Z1 refuses to run.

apy.detail: APY is not emitted and cannot be inferred from these tables.

emissions.detail: Claim-credit issuance, vesting, settlement, and token burn flows are emitted per epoch.

fdv.detail: FDV is not emitted and cannot be inferred from these tables.

governance.detail: No governance process or authority is modeled.

liquidity.detail: No liquidity pool, depth, or market module is part of the M1 core-solvency model.

staking.detail: No staking pool, reward source, or staking yield is modeled at this milestone.

supply.detail: Audience reserve, treasury, cohort balances, and burns are conserved per epoch under the Z1 M1 supply identity; conservation is verified every epoch.

unavailable_concepts.reason: The M1 core-solvency model emits no liquidity depth or pool state.
The scenario models no governance process or authority.

variability.explanation: Canonical bundles pin repetitions=1: a single deterministic path per scenario provides no statistical uncertainty evidence.
